title: Modaraba Companies and Modaraba Floatation and Control Amendment Ordinance 1985

sections.shortTitle: Modaraba Companies and Modaraba Floatation and Control Amendment Ordinance 1985
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XIX OF 1985
ORDINANCE XIX OF
1985
MODARABA COMPANIES
AND MODARABA FLOATATION AND CONTROL) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1985
An
Ordinance to amend the Modaraba Companies and Modaraba (Floatation and Control)
Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 13th March, 1985]
No. 17 (1)/85-Pub.-The following
Ordinance, made by the President, is hereby published for general information
:-
1. Short title and commencement.-(1) This Ordinance may be called the Modaraba Companies and
Modaraba (Floatation and Control) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

ORDINANCE XIX OF
1985
MODARABA COMPANIES
AND MODARABA FLOATATION AND CONTROL) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1985
An
Ordinance to amend the Modaraba Companies and Modaraba (Floatation and Control)
Ordinance, 1980
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 13th March, 1985]
No. 17 (1)/85-Pub.-The following
Ordinance, made by the President, is hereby published for general information
:-
2. Amendment of section 19, Ordinance XXXI of 1980.-In the Modaraba Companies and
Modaraba (Floatation and Control) Ordinance, 1980 (XXXI of 1980), hereinafter
referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 19, after subsection (4), the
following new subsection shall be added, namely :-
"(5) An
appeal preferred under subsection (1) shall be disposed of by the Federal
Government after giving the appellant an opportunity of being heard.".
